title: Healthy Tom
text:
Tom likes to be healthy. He eats fruit every day. He drinks a lot of water. He walks to school with his friend.

On Sunday, Tom plays football in the park. He runs fast and he laughs a lot. After the game, he eats a sandwich with cheese. He goes to bed early.

questions.text: What does Tom eat every day?
What does Tom play on Sunday?

options: He eats good food and is active

questions.text: How does Tom probably feel after the game?

vocabulary.definition: not sick; good for your body
a clear drink that we need every day
a sport played with a ball and two teams
two slices of bread with food between them

paragraph_translations: Tomek lubi być zdrowy. Je owoce każdego dnia. Pije dużo wody. Idzie do szkoły z kolegą.
W niedzielę Tomek gra w piłkę nożną w parku. Biega szybko i dużo się śmieje. Po meczu je kanapkę z serem. Idzie spać wcześnie.
